name: msp-skills
description: Free Claude Code skills + MCP servers for HaloPSA tickets and Servosity backups. For MSP business owners - works with Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, and any MCP-capable agent.

plugins.name: connectwise-manage
plugins.description: Every ConnectWise PSA workflow from the terminal  -  with a typed conditions query builder, offline SQLite sync, and cross-entity views (unbilled work, account 360, board triage) the PSA web UI can't give you.

plugins.name: halopsa
plugins.description: Add HaloPSA ticket triage, SLA-breach pre-emption, and cross-client analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or any AI that speaks MCP. Local SQLite mirror so cross-entity queries the live API can't return are fast and offline.

plugins.name: hubspot
plugins.description: Every HubSpot Sales Hub feature, plus offline cross-object queries, property-change-history reporting, and an agent-native data layer no other HubSpot tool has.

plugins.name: msp-skills-concierge
plugins.description: Tell it your MSP stack and it recommends the msp-skills connectors that fit, then installs only the ones you approve. Reads the live catalog, states an honest verification badge per connector, and reports install receipts. Markdown-only, no binary.

plugins.name: mspbots
plugins.description: The first MSPbots tool anywhere — readable filters, alias-named resources, full exports, and the KPI history MSPbots itself doesn't keep.

plugins.name: n-central
plugins.description: Every N-central REST endpoint, plus an offline SQLite mirror of your whole org tree, cross-tenant search, issue-triage rollups, and a JWT-expiry guardian no other N-central tool has.

plugins.name: servosity
plugins.description: The first MSP-fleet CLI for backup. Every Servosity API endpoint as a typed command, plus a local mirror that lets you ask questions the dashboard can't — across your whole book of clients.

plugins.name: superops
plugins.description: Every SuperOps PSA+RMM entity in your terminal, plus a local SQLite mirror that answers cross-entity questions the web UI can't.

plugins.name: pax8
plugins.description: Every Pax8 Partner API endpoint, plus an offline store that reconciles billing, tracks MRR, and catches usage overages no Pax8 tool surfaces.

plugins.name: threatlocker
plugins.description: Every ThreatLocker Portal API feature, plus the write operations the read-only tools lack and a cross-tenant offline store no other ThreatLocker tool has.
